lines: Switching acne products every week can cause breakouts.
Dermatologists say give a product six to eight weeks.
But your mirror can't tell you if it's working.
Glowi scans your skin and gives it a skin score.
With Premium, a twenty-eight day skin cycle shows how it changes.
So you judge your routine on scans, not on a bad mirror day.
Your first scan is free. Link in bio.
